_notes: min_set_id drops old sets the source lists without a real release date (POP Series, Nintendo Promos, EX Trainer Kits...). include_set_ids: 2545 = SWSH Sword & Shield Promo Cards (dated Nov 2019). exclude_set_ids: 2374 = Miscellaneous Cards & Products. set_dates fixes release dates the source lacks (2776 = First Partner Pack). undated_set_ids are promo groups that span years (SWSH/SV/ME promos, Prize Pack Series, Southeast Asia Exclusives), so set age is ignored for them and a card's own first-seen date is used instead. backfill_days: how far back history is loaded from tcgcsv's archives, archives_per_run at a time on the daily run only. max_rows_per_set caps each drop section per set; stable-price cards are never capped. Record lows need 60 days of the card's own history. history_start: tcgcsv's archives begin 2024-02-08; backfill_days reaches back to it. pricecheck_rule_since: the price-check rule was fixed on this date; scorecard dates from here on count as live.
